text:
alex: FYI deploybot rejected a staging publish to eu-central-1. Missing build_id in manifest annotations. image=redwood/payments:staging-2026-03-21, digest=sha256:c0ffee123...

deploy-bot: publish aborted: provenance.guard -> missing: build_id. promotion halted by promote-config.

nina: i saw a flaky write in the emit-provenance step on retries earlier today. logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/emit-provenance/789

alex: release window 14:00-16:00 UTC. If we can't get a verified image by 15:30, decision is to pin and proceed.

release-mgr: prefer pin to previous digest for canary. schedule republish attempt after window at 17:00 UTC. Avoid blocking other teams.

nina: i can try a manual republish with injected annotations + cosign attestation. That should be quick if the registry accepts it.

ci-bot: note: previous attestation uploads sometimes ended in wrong bucket causing predicateType mismatch. double-check predicate and bucket.

alex: ops-oncall, please add an audit entry if we pin. Include reason: missing provenance build_id.

ops-oncall: logged incident INC-2026-0425, added audit note.

nina: manual republish commands i plan to run:
`jq '.annotations["build_id"]="bk-44444"' manifest.raw > manifest.meta.json`
`aws ecr put-image --repository redwood/payments --image-manifest file://manifest.meta.json --image-tag staging-2026-03-21`
`cosign attach-attestation --predicate-file att.json --image $REPO:staging-2026-03-21`

release-mgr: Decision: pin to previous digest sha256:baadf00d... for immediate canary/promote. Nina to attempt republish at 17:00 UTC; if successful and attestation verifies, we'll retag and roll forward in next change window.

alex: nina, open a PR with the temporary pin + release note blurb. I'll approve quickly.

nina: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/releases/pull/470. adding ETA for republish.

ops-oncall: added deployment ledger entry for temporary pin and linked PR.

alex: thanks all. closing once republish result and PR merge are recorded.
